summary: Can-Fite BioPharma filed a Form 6-K reporting an inducement offer letter with a warrant holder. The holder will exercise existing warrants for 1,591,738 ADSs at a reduced price of $2.50 per ADS (down from $5.00), yielding gross proceeds of about $4.0 million. In exchange, the company issued new warrants for up to 3,183,476 ADSs at $2.50, plus placement agent warrants. H.C. Wainwright acted as placement agent, receiving 7% cash fee and other fees. Closing is expected around September 3, 2026. This is a routine equity financing transaction, not a special situation, so it should be classified as None. Watch for potential dilution from new warrants and registration statement effectiveness.
